text: Based on the output, there were no fire detections on the asset during the evaluated period from September 23, 2026, to October 23, 2026. The data from NASA FIRMS, which includes detections from VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21, and MODIS, shows zero detections intersecting the asset. All sensors had full coverage of the asset during the entire period. Therefore, it can be concluded that there was no fire on the asset during this time.
